alex_cheng: quick check — pushed a small change to staging and the worker printed a trimmed 20-char prefix of a third-party API key in the logs. it looks like `ak_abc123...xyz789` (truncated). do we need an immediate rotate or is redaction enough? :facepalm:

maria_gupta: if it's truncated (not the whole key) it's lower risk, but we treat any secret leakage as a trigger. did you capture which service or log file? can you paste the exact line (sanitized) and the log path?

alex_cheng: sure, sanitized snippet below and path: `/var/log/redwood/staging/worker.log`
```
2025-08-12T14:22:03Z INFO third_party.sync request failed token=ak_abc123...xyz789 status=401
```

samir_khan: tagging the security runbook: https://intra.redwood.example/docs/secrets/when-to-rotate. short answer: if the substring is part of the token format and could be reconstructed, rotate. if it's an obvious truncation and provider keys are long and hashed, we can assess with the vendor.

alex_cheng: we don't have the full token. vendor support (AcmeAPI) says their keys are 40 chars and the leaked prefix is 10 chars. i'm leaning rotate but want to confirm approvals and impact (staging creds only vs prod).

security_bot: INCIDENT-TRACKER created: INC-2025-0821-7. Please add owner and risk assessment. Required approvers: security_team_lead, infra_owner. See runbook: https://intra.redwood.example/playbooks/secret-leak.

oncall_ops: for staging-only keys we can rotate without wide outage. alex, can you open a short MR to rotate the key in vault and update the staging deploy? If you need help, ping me and I can run the rollout. :thumbsup:

alex_cheng: created MR #4521 to add new staging key (vault path: secret/staging/thirdparty/acmeapi) and a small deploy script. PTAL: https://git.redwood.example/r/redwood/infra/merge_requests/4521. Also added the incident note with risk=low-medium.

maria_gupta: thanks. one quick nit — make sure the MR doesn't include the key literal anywhere (logs/artifacts). use `vault write` in CI and check pipeline artifacts. also add a simple grep test in the pipeline to fail on plaintext tokens: `grep -E "ak_[A-Za-z0-9]{6}" -R --exclude=*.enc`

samir_khan: adding a short policy reminder: devs should run `scripts/scrub-logs.sh` before uploading debug bundles. small snippet: `sed -E 's/(ak_[A-Za-z0-9]{6})/REDACTED/g' worker.log > worker.log.scrubbed`

oncall_ops: approved - rolling key rotation now, will coordinate with staging deploy in ~10m. alex, once rotated run a quick smoke test against AcmeAPI to confirm behavior.

alex_cheng: done. rotated, redeployed, smoke test passed. deleted the old key from vault and added a note to the incident. thanks everyone. :relieved:

security_bot: INC-2025-0821-7 status=resolved by oncall_ops. Reminder: add a short postmortem if this recurs.
